description: Find home-service providers (plumbers, electricians, cleaners, handymen, etc.) on GeraHome. Tries the live GeraHome production API first; if unreachable or empty, falls back to real crawled provider records bundled with this server (currently Yerevan, sourced from List.am/Spyur). Read-only — finds providers; it does not book anything. The result's "data_source" field tells you whether rows are live or bundled seed. Pass these provider ids to create_booking_intent to start a consent-first booking.
name: search_home_services
title: Search GeraHome home-service providers
